summary: Add the SMS connectors of automation graphs, pkg/automation/connectors/sms: eskiz and twilio with the nodes eskiz.send_sms and twilio.send_sms (not idempotent: a send of unknown outcome ends as failed with outcome_unknown and is never repeated; only 429/408 are repeated after Retry-After), usage accounting in unit sms, platform credentials (opt_in) from the environment, and HTTP fakes in sms/smstest. New stdconfig/eskizconfig (ESKIZ_URL, ESKIZ_EMAIL, ESKIZ_PASSWORD, ESKIZ_FROM) registered in the stdconfig bundle; the automations module registers both connectors. pkg/eskiz.NewService accepts ServiceOption WithRoundTripper, and its token refresher no longer repeats a login the provider refused with a 4xx.
